firstMismatch.message: Replay error: PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE is not defined

mismatch.message: Replay error: PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE is not defined

summary: The admitted v69 cube-contents replay stops before its first matched screen because JS mon.c:meatbox references PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE without importing it. C compares the consumed monster species with mons[PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE] and routes a cube’s contained objects to mpickobj. The JS function already implements that branch; importing the source constant restores the species check and lets the recorded case exercise the contents path.

source.branch: When a monster consumes a container with contents at a valid map position, meatbox checks whether the monster is a gelatinous cube. C calls mpickobj for each child when it is a cube; otherwise it reports the spill and applies floor effects before placement.

evidence: The admitted v69 baseline was evaluated against f5371e6adf39dfbf6b3bc839f5d6d96195f0536f; its recorded case has 510 steps, and the saved evaluation stops with “PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE is not defined” before any screen matches. The admission record is challenges/evaluations/admission-f5371e6adf39dfbf6b3bc839f5d6d96195f0536f-v69.json.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/mon.c:1354-1390 defines meatbox: it compares mon->data with &mons[PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE], then routes each container child through mpickobj for a cube or flooreffects/place_object otherwise. nethack-c/upstream/src/mon.c:m_consume_obj calls meatbox whenever the consumed object has contents.

The source callers include nethack-c/upstream/src/dogmove.c:dog_eat, monmove.c:gelcube_digests, and mon.c:mpickstuff. Their JS counterparts call the existing async m_consume_obj/meatbox chain in js/dogmove.js, js/monmove.js, and js/mon.js.

In js/mon.js:1422-1427, meatbox evaluates state.mons?.[PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE]. The module’s only monsters.js import block at js/mon.js:~450-565 omits PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE, although js/monsters.js exports it as index 8. The missing binding is therefore the direct cause; the branch body and callers already exist.

Actionable change is confined to importing PM_GELATINOUS_CUBE in js/mon.js and adding a focused test that exercises the cube branch through m_consume_obj. The admitted v69 recording will provide production entry-point evidence after the import is corrected.
